approach.title:
One project command.
Local development and CI.
approach.description: The Taskfiles project captures an approach I value: put shared behavior behind a clear interface, then let different projects use it.
approach.detail: Projects define their commands. Reusable modules handle execution. Containers provide the selected tools. CI handles checkout, credentials, and artifacts.
approach.demoNote: Interactive explanation based on the project example. No commands execute here.
approach.boundary: The command is shared. Host architecture, credentials, runtime, and cache can still differ.
